before.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value.
before.reason: The object printer passes each member to print_value, which supports cJSON_Raw. Parsing cannot create that type, and the old harness performs no member construction.

after.requirement: Reach printing of an object containing a constructed cJSON_Raw member value.
after.reason: The raw member printing route remains supported. The same old harness still prints only parsed trees, whose members cannot have cJSON_Raw type.

claims.reason: On both sides, the old harness obtains its printed tree solely through parsing and never inserts a raw object member.
